# Noor & Vaani

Noor & Vaani is a design prototype for a premium Indian home decor and gifting storefront. It launches with festive Diwali products — diyas, lanterns, fairy lights, rangoli kits and gift hampers — and is structured to expand into year-round home decor, textiles and accessories.

## Pages
- Home: hero campaign "Illuminate Your Diwali — Festive Decor & Gift Sale", category showcase, trending products, gift hamper editorial, lighting spotlight, inspiration, newsletter.
- Collections: /collections/shop-all plus /collections/lights, /collections/decor, /collections/gifts, /collections/apparel with working filters and sorting.
- Product detail: /products/elegant-brass-diya-lanterns-set-of-4 (featured demo product with variants, gallery and FAQs).
- Cart: /cart with quantity, removal, subtotal and a configurable free-shipping threshold (₹999 demo).
- Wishlist: /wishlist.
- Search: /search.
- Info pages: /pages/about, /pages/contact, /pages/faq, /pages/track-order, /pages/shipping-policy, /pages/returns-refunds, /pages/privacy-policy, /pages/terms-of-service.

## Notes
- All products, prices, ratings and policies are clearly labelled demonstration data for a design prototype; the production build is planned as a Shopify Liquid theme with real catalogue data and Shopify's hosted checkout.
